text: Hey, we missed you in the economics lecture on Tuesday. Is everything alright? I had a bad cold, so I stayed home. Could I borrow your notes from that day? Of course. My handwriting is messy, though, so I could send you photos or type them up. Photos are fine, I just need to see the main points before the quiz. No problem. The professor also said the quiz on Friday will focus on the last two chapters. That is really helpful to know. I will start reviewing those chapters tonight. There was also a diagram on the board. I drew it at the bottom of the second page. I will look for the diagram on the second page. If anything is unclear, we could review together tomorrow before class. That would help. I will read the notes first and bring my questions.
